findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (final House second-reading vote)
findings.note: Member vote record on HB 958 (Election Law Changes). The ratified text requires a registration application to affirmatively state US citizenship (with a sworn-statement notice process if blank) and orders a removal process for voters flagged as non-citizens by a federal database. It also changes precinct-official and list-maintenance rules. It has no photo-ID section. Roll call 758: member voted No; tally 66 Aye, 47 No; bill passed.

findings.motion: Co-sponsor, HB 691 Voter Protection and Reliance Act
findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor of HB 691. The bill says votes cast under the rules in place on election day cannot be discounted because of later changes, and speeds up late election lawsuits. It does not set an ID or citizenship rule.
subjects: voters relying on rules in place on election day

findings.note: He is on the sponsor list of House Bill 691, Voter Protection and Reliance Act (not a primary sponsor). The bill text says every citizen has the right to have a vote counted under the laws and procedures in place on election day, and bars officials and courts from excluding votes under a law or ruling not in effect on election day. It does not set an ID or citizenship rule. Referred to House Rules on 2025-04-03.
